<?php

use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;

uses(RefreshDatabase::class);

test('project factory creates a valid project', function () {
    $project = Project::factory()->create();

    expect($project)->toBeInstanceOf(Project::class)
        ->and($project->id)->toBeGreaterThan(0)
        ->and($project->title)->toBeString()
        ->and($project->description)->toBeString()
        ->and($project->is_active)->toBeIn([true, false])
        ->and($project->user_id)->toBeGreaterThan(0);
});

test('project belongs to a user', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();
    $project = Project::factory()->create(['user_id' => $user->id]);

    expect($project->user)->toBeInstanceOf(User::class)
        ->and($project->user->id)->toBe($user->id);
});

test('project is_active defaults to true', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();
    $project = Project::factory()->create(['user_id' => $user->id]);

    expect($project->is_active)->toBeTrue();
});

test('project can be created with fillable attributes', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();
    $project = Project::create([
        'user_id' => $user->id,
        'title' => 'Test Project',
        'description' => 'A test project description',
        'is_active' => false,
    ]);

    expect($project->title)->toBe('Test Project')
        ->and($project->description)->toBe('A test project description')
        ->and($project->is_active)->toBeFalse();
});

test('user has many projects', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();
    Project::factory(3)->create(['user_id' => $user->id]);

    expect($user->projects()->count())->toBe(3);
});
